## Checklist

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/gridfm/gridfm-trustlayer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.

- [ ] Tests for the new behaviour, on small synthetic data; `pytest` passes.
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes (ruff, mypy, tests).
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour or options changed; `mkdocs build --strict` passes.
- [ ] New or changed config keys: validation, config builder, examples and configuration reference updated.
- [ ] Entry in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) for the DCO check.
